thread:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Paging SRE oncall: High latency spike detected for model-serving-cluster-eta (us-west-2). p95 = 1.25s, p99 = 4.3s, streaming stall rate +12%. Alert INC-20260315-783. Auto-run diagnostics started.

Devon: I'm seeing the same in the dashboards, routing errors up too. starting traces for top 5 clients.

Marta: grabbing kv cache metrics (prefill/decode). fragmentation ratio looks high on a subset of nodes. prefill ops are dominating background io.

Kevin: any recent deploys or config changes?

Devon: no deploys in last 60m. autoscaler did add two pods ~10m ago after burst.

Priya: @Marta can you paste the command you used to surface per-node prefill vs decode?

Marta: sure:```sh
# per-node counters
kubectl exec -it svc/kv-metrics -n infra -- /bin/sh -c "curl -s http://localhost:9090/metrics | grep -E 'kv_prefill_ops|kv_decode_ops' | sort"
```

Marta: output snippet:```text
node-12 kv_prefill_ops_total 412345
node-12 kv_decode_ops_total  12345
node-13 kv_prefill_ops_total 389001
node-13 kv_decode_ops_total  13210
node-14 kv_prefill_ops_total 401223
node-14 kv_decode_ops_total  11590
```

Devon: wow, prefill >> decode on those nodes. looks like prefill work is contending with decode threads and causing tail stalls — likely eviction thrash/fragmentation.

SRE-Triage: Confirming correlation: nodes with high prefill ratio show 95th/99th spike and increased disk io wait.

Kevin: what's the immediate mitigation? Can we throttle prefill, move it to lower priority, or reduce concurrency?

Marta: we can flip prefill to background-priority and reduce concurrency by changing config in kv-configmap. patch suggestion: set prefill.max_concurrency: 8 -> 2 and prefill.priority: low.

Priya: If we change that, will it impact cold-start latencies for customers?

Marta: Slightly for first-token on long-tail queries that rely on prefill warming. But right now tail latency and streaming stalls are customer-visible; need to favor stability.

Devon: I'll apply a temporary throttling patch to the staging config and then to prod canary. command:```sh
kubectl patch configmap/kv-config -n infra --type merge -p '{"data":{"prefill.max_concurrency":"2","prefill.priority":"low"}}'
```

Devon: applied to canary subset (node-12). Observing metrics...

(60s)

Devon: canary nodes show 40% drop in io wait, p95 dropped to 720ms on those nodes, p99 down to 1.1s. overall cluster p95 moved from 1.25s -> 890ms.

Kevin: good. roll to remaining nodes but do it gradual. schedule 1 node every 30s, monitor streaming stall rate.

Priya: I'm opening a quick runbook entry for the patch and a customer impact note draft for SRE->Support.

SRE-Triage: creating incident channel and tagging customers with increased error/latency. We should set postmortem owner.

Devon: rolling patch to remaining nodes now (batch size = 1, pause 30s).

Marta: also adding a runtime metric alert for prefill/decode imbalance so we catch this earlier: condition if prefill/ decode > 10 for > 5m.

(5m)

Devon: rollout complete. cluster p95 = 650ms, p99 = 980ms, streaming stall rate back to baseline. No additional errors.

Priya: customer-impact note: "Root cause: KV prefill pressure causing eviction/fragmentation and IO contention on a subset of nodes which increased tail latencies and caused streaming stalls. Mitigation: reduced prefill concurrency and backgrounded prefill operations to lower priority; rolled to all nodes. Current status: metrics recovered; monitoring continuing. Action items: follow-up config tuning, long-term scheduling changes, and an eval of prefill flow to avoid eviction thrash."

Kevin: assign postmortem to Marta + Devon. include perf graphs, node-level traces, and suggestions for automated throttling policy.

Marta: I'll own the follow-up perf work. plan to prototype adaptive prefill that watches decode pipeline lag and scales prefill tokens accordingly.

SRE-Triage: handing off to the daytime oncall in 10m. @Priya please paste handoff summary.

Priya: Handoff summary: "INC-20260315-783: Latency spike due to KV prefill pressure. Mitigation applied: prefill.max_concurrency -> 2, prefill.priority -> low across cluster. Observed p95/p99 reduction and streaming stall recovery. Monitoring alerts added. Postmortem owner: Marta + Devon. Follow-ups scheduled." :thumbsup:

Devon: leaving final logs and commands in the incident channel. If anything regresses ping SRE-Triage and we can re-open.

oncall-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident marked resolved by oncall with note: "mitigation applied; monitoring stable" at ts 1779001800

Priya: closing thread, moving to incidents for postmortem drafting. Thanks team :)
